answer: Before first payout, the holder links a registered weather station on their terrace, its number and a signed reading from a gale. Two verifiers match both against the weather service record in a week; reading claimed twice, or no station on file, closes both. A station costs 3 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand stations and 3 billion. The terrace anemometer spins in the gale as a comet crosses the sky.
